Network Technology Case Studies Fact Sheets and Guides Reports Glossary Trackers and Dashboards Webinars Start Here Digital Opportunity Lab Start a Community Network Sign Up For a Network Educate Your Local Community Subscribe Donate Predictions for 2023 - Episode 535 of the Community Broadband Bits Podcast By Ry Marcattilio on Jan 18, 2023 This week on the show, the staff get together to bend their collective imagination to what we expect to see as the biggest news stories of 2023. Returning to join Christopher are Sean Gonsalves, Christine Parker, Emma Gautier, and Ry Marcattilio to discuss the BEAD funding rollout, mapping, the current state of preemption laws, Starry, the FCC, and more. Who will be right? Wrong? We'll have to wait until December to find out! This show is 46 minutes long and can be played on this page or via Apple Podcasts or the tool of your choice using this feed .
